Reviewer: egg pool job review-4366, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney (seat bacon); did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: no blockers. Ready for the maintainer to decide Q1 and Q2 and merge at the cut.**

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes which face an operation machines. I re-ran four mutations and read the whole diff (the 9 commits of this PR and the 5 commits of #4364 that it holds).

The three commits that the body calls "never compiled" now compile, and their tests pass. The requested `facet_order` red/green check is done (see "Mutations").

## What looks good

- The follow refuses each doubtful case by name (`Lost`), and a lost pick stays as it was, so generation refuses it as before. A wrong follow is the case that the code guards. A missed follow is only the old behaviour.
- A followed pick puts a `needs_review` line on its operation. The line holds the post until `mark_operation_reviewed`. `follow::a_followed_pick_holds_the_post_until_the_operation_is_marked_reviewed` pins this.
- All writes are in the one `UpdateModel` undo step. `invert` puts back the operations, the meta and the record.
- `source_faces::of` reads a record only at the revision and facet count that it landed with. A repair, a non-`.sc` update or a vise rebuild makes it stale.
- The project key `source_faces` never refuses a file (`lenient`, `to_record`). A bad record is dropped with a logged note.
- The `stores` walk takes `Operation` and `AreaControls` apart with no `..`. A new field that holds picks does not build until someone classifies it.
- Probe and Slot picks do not follow, because their picks set numbers in the parameters. I checked: `probe_from_picks` and `slot_from_picks` are the only seed-from-pick paths.
- The kernel name reader never refuses an import, and it bounds the name length and the allocation.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests. All new files are below 400 lines. Each new module has a provenance line.
- No new crate dependency and no new top-level test binary. The new tests join `model_link`, `import_solidcraft`, `solidcraft_import` and the geometry `solidcraft` suite.
- No process file, `build.rs`, script, workflow or `Cargo.toml` change.

## Mutations (each reverted after the run)

1. `update_model_follow.rs` `plan`: put back `model::features_of_shared` for the two `feature::features_of_facets` calls. **Red**: `facet_order::a_cached_facet_order_of_the_same_triangles_does_not_move_a_pick` fails at `facet_order.rs:53` (the `src_of` assert). The pick goes to the back face `Face(16544119459504167024)`. This is the failure that the body predicts, so the test reaches the hazard.
2. `source_follow.rs`: disable the `Lost::Shared` guard. **Red**: `source_follow::tests::two_old_faces_never_meet_on_one_new_face`.
3. `source_follow.rs`: disable the `Lost::NotNew` guard. **Red**: `source_follow::tests::a_name_that_moved_to_a_carried_face_does_not_follow`. The `model_link` suite stays green, so only the geometry lib pins this guard.
4. `update_model_follow.rs`: do not push the `needs_review` line. **Red**: four `model_link` tests, among them `a_followed_pick_holds_the_post_until_the_operation_is_marked_reviewed`.

Goldens moved: none. The diff changes no `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

- **Maintainer decisions Q1 and Q2 are open on #4213.** The code uses the recommended options (no version step; follow with a review line that holds the post). D4 and D5 record them. Q1 depends on time: if this PR merges after a release writes v84, a released v84 build drops the key.
- **Stack.** This PR holds the 5 commits of #4364. A merge of this PR also lands #4364. Merge #4364 first, or close it when this PR merges. This review read and tested the code of both.
- This is a `feat`: it merges at the next cut.

## Follow-ups (file after merge)

- P7: one sentence for the new `picks` key of the `import_model` answer in `docs/agents/mcp-tools.md`. The body names it as owed.
- P7: the hover text of the review banner (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/op_page.rs`) and the `mark_operation_reviewed` MCP description say "migration". A review line can now also come from a name follow at a re-import. The body names it as owed.
- P7: the `model_link` suite does not pin the `NotNew` guard at the command level (mutation 3). One integration case would close that.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
